## Decisions and follow-ups

- Every managed site must have analytics; an agent may not remove it based on preference.
- Analytics behavior is owner controlled and recorded in `site.md`.
- WebNR's required mode is `full-url`; complete browser URLs and query parameters must be sent to GA4.
- WebNR public documentation must clearly disclose that imported URLs in `?add=...` are included in reported page URLs.
- A runtime script tag alone is not proof. Source, generated output, exact production deployment, public loader/configuration, and later provider evidence must all be checked.
- Missing GA4 or Search Console exports are missing evidence, not zero traffic.
- Existing documentation-deployment and permanent production-evidence work remains active and must not be bypassed.
- Future product priorities remain backup/restore, IndexedDB migrations, E2E/accessibility/offline tests, stable releases, real EPUB parsing, and versioned clean-room Legado compatibility fixtures.
